subject: fire mage in a crimson hooded robe holding a gnarled staff topped with an ember crystal
motion: slamming the staff down to erupt flames from the ground
facing: in a three-quarter view facing screen-right
effects: orange flames bursting up from the ground in front of the mage

plan.source: Mage in crimson hood faces right three-quarter; left hand holds an upright gnarled staff with ember crystal, right arm extended pointing; right foot forward, left back, relaxed stance.

frames.pose: Anticipation: torso leans back; left hand lifts staff behind left shoulder, top angled back; right hand retracts to chest; knees dip; hips shift over left leg; head tilts to ground ahead; both feet planted.
frames.effect: Small ember sparkles gather at the crystal; faint upward trail from the lifted staff.

frames.pose: Key: torso snaps forward; left arm slams staff down, tip hitting ground before right toe; right arm swings back; deep knee bend, weight over right; head at impact; both feet planted.
frames.effect: Bright arc along the staff’s downswing; ground impact flare and tall orange flames burst up in front of the mage.

frames.pose: Follow-through: torso pitched forward; left hand pins staff tip to ground ahead; right arm thrown back for balance; knees still bent; head follows flames; both feet planted.
frames.effect: Flame column peaks in front, tapering upward; ember sparks trail above the burst.

frames.pose: Recovery: torso straightens; left hand slides staff upright beside left hip; right arm comes forward, palm open; knees easing to neutral; head lifts; both feet planted.
frames.effect: Low licking flames at the impact spot in front fading; a few drifting embers remain.
